title: La pasiva en todas sus formas: having been told, might have been lost

rule.title: The passive in all its forms
rule.explanation:
A nivel C1 la pasiva aparece en cualquier tiempo y con modales, sobre todo en narraciones y textos formales:
- Past perfect: «I had been given a key before I arrived.»
- Future perfect: «By the time we get there, all the seats will have been taken.»
- Modal perfect: «The umbrella might have been destroyed by the wind.», «It can't have been stolen.»
- Continua: «I felt I was being watched.», «The road is being repaired.»
- Participio perfecto («having been» + participio): «Having been told it rained a lot, I bought an umbrella.»
- Infinitivo y gerundio: «She hates being interrupted.», «He's going to be given an award.», «I'd like to be told the truth.»
- Con verbos de dos objetos, el sujeto suele ser la persona: «I was given a key.» (mejor que «A key was given to me»)

El agente con «by» solo se añade si aporta información:
- «Harbour Studio was founded by Helen twenty years ago.»

Ojo: «been» va tras «have» o «having»; «being», en las formas continuas y como gerundio; «be», tras modales y «to».

rows: I had been given a key.
The seats will have been taken.
He's going to be given an award.
